content:
Solve \( |x| = \left|\frac{x+1}{2x+4}\right| \).

Case 1:
\[
x=\frac{x+1}{2x+4} \implies 2x^2+3x-1=0
\]
Roots:
\[
x=\frac{-3\pm\sqrt{17}}{4}
\]

Case 2:
\[
x=-\frac{x+1}{2x+4} \implies 2x^2+5x+1=0
\]
Roots:
\[
x=\frac{-5\pm\sqrt{17}}{4}
\]

Sum of all four solutions:
\[
\frac{-3+\sqrt{17}-3-\sqrt{17}-5+\sqrt{17}-5-\sqrt{17}}{4}
= \frac{-16}{4} = -4
\]

\[
\boxed{-4}
\]
